model_a.description: Exact original strategy: both directions, fixed $10 risk, Pine quantities, TradingView documented fill emulator, no fees, no capital limit.

fill_property_sensitivity.name: documented default (limit gap fills at open; exits may fill on the entry's tick path)
exit one tick after entry fill

conservative_fill_replay.description: Separate replay: a resting limit (entry or TP2) fills only if price trades one tick through it. Changes which trades happen; not comparable trade-for-trade with A/B.

model_c_note: Long-only, balance-limited (entry value + entry fee ≤ available balance, no leverage or borrowing), $5,000 Worker order limit, Ndax $5 minimum, Ndax costs (fees and slippage) deducted from the balance at each close. A refused entry is dropped exactly as the live engine does, so the strategy's later trades can differ from A. A refused entry that filled and exited inside one candle is removed from the executed list (it never reached the ledger). Every short of Model A is unrepresentable on the current ledger.

dataset.source: Kraken public Trades API (SOLUSD), aggregated to 5m candles; completed candles only
